Container.Name: packwright
Container.Overview:
Manage PS5 dump, image and package collections from your browser. Packwright has a library with search, convert between folder, exFAT, FFPKG, FFPFSC, ZArchive and debug package, verify, extract, repair, merge packages downloaded in parts, and send to a console.
This is the Packwright desktop app running on the server and shown in the browser (noVNC), so it works on your games at the server's own disk speed instead of over a network share.
Sign-in is always on: set a username and password below before the first start. The page is served over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, so the browser asks you to accept it once. More accounts: docker exec -it packwright webauth-user add NAME.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: The share or folder that holds your games. Packwright scans it as its library and writes results there.

Config.Name: Work files
Config.Description: Where conversions unpack a game while they work. It needs as much free space as your largest game; a cache pool is fastest.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, library cache, logs, the HTTPS certificate and the sign-in file.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: The name you sign in with.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: The password you sign in with.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Files are written as this user (99 is nobody, Unraid's default).

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Files are written with this group (100 is users).

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: Permissions for new files. 0000 matches Unraid shares.

Config.Name: Screen width
Config.Description: Width of the screen shown in the browser.

Config.Name: Screen height
Config.Description: Height of the screen shown in the browser.

Config.Name: Dark mode
Config.Description: 1 for dark window frames and dialogs, 0 for light.

Config.Name: Use HTTPS
Config.Description: 1 serves the page over HTTPS, which sign-in needs. Set 0 only behind your own HTTPS reverse proxy, and then also set WEB_AUTHENTICATION_ALLOW_INSECURE to 1.
